# Architecture reference archive

The names in this directory are a provenance index for architectural research,
not vendored source code. APRIL does not copy or import source from these
projects. Their source locations, revisions, and licenses are not asserted by
this repository because no source was supplied in the checkout.

The entries are deliberately `metadata_only` in
`third_party/source-manifest.json`, have no production dependency edge, and
are excluded from APRIL's Python package surface.

The archived reference names are Mnem, AgentMW, Praxos, OpenVURP, Anybridge,
Tools-Factory, Coocon, and llm-use. Their source is not copied here.
